dataset.name: BACAP prospective primary-PDAC biopsy cohort (GSE253260)
dataset.description: Prospective multicenter pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma cohort with pretreatment primary-tumor bulk RNA sequencing and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The French BACAP cohort prospectively enrolled patients with cytologically or pathologically confirmed PDAC before treatment, regardless of resectability or metastatic stage. GSE253260 publishes 397 primary-tumor endoscopic-ultrasound fine-needle-aspiration wash profiles. TRACE Explorer retains 380 patients with a released count-matrix column and complete positive overall-survival time/status.

metadata.source_program: Biological and clinical database for pancreatic adenocarcinoma (BACAP)
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and the CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 publication
metadata.library_method: Lexogen QuantSeq 3-prime FWD bulk RNA sequencing of pretreatment primary-PDAC endoscopic-ultrasound fine-needle-aspiration biopsy wash material; reads were aligned to Ensembl GRCh38 with STAR and counted with featureCounts
metadata.endpoint_context: Source-provided overall survival in months for a prospective all-stage PDAC cohort
metadata.endpoint_caveat: GEO publishes exact individual OS and PFS duration/status but does not state the clinical time origin in the family metadata. TRACE Explorer preserves source-defined OS without inferring a diagnosis, biopsy or treatment origin.
metadata.sample_selection_note: Every GEO record represents one primary-PDAC biopsy from one normalized patient identifier. BPC137T is excluded before endpoint evaluation because the pinned 396-column count matrix omits that otherwise listed GEO sample. Fourteen additional records lack a complete endpoint and two have non-positive follow-up, leaving 380 OS-eligible profiles.
metadata.expression_processing_note: TRACE Explorer calculates library sizes across all 60,671 pinned source Ensembl rows, applies log2(CPM + 1), maps versionless identifiers with Ensembl release 95 GRCh38 and excludes symbols represented by multiple Ensembl genes rather than silently aggregating them.
metadata.expression_curation_note: The pinned matrix contains 60,671 unique versionless Ensembl rows. Ensembl release 95 maps 58,453 rows to 56,912 symbols; 160 symbols represented by more than one Ensembl gene are excluded rather than combined, leaving 56,752 unambiguous analyzable symbols.
metadata.clinical_covariate_note: GEO supplies exact age and sex plus the source disease-stage category for the retained records. Resectable, borderline, locally advanced and metastatic labels are preserved as categorical source stage.
metadata.overlap_note: The prospective French BACAP cohort is institutionally and accession-wise distinct from TCGA-PAAD and from the other active external pancreatic-cancer releases in TRACE Explorer.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the pinned public GEO files in place. Source-file redistribution remains disabled; NCBI GEO terms and the article's CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 license remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: Pretreatment primary-PDAC endoscopic-ultrasound fine-needle-aspiration biopsy wash, one bulk RNA profile per patient

expression.label: GEO raw counts normalized to log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Pinned Ensembl release 95 GRCh38 gene_name annotation
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Symbols mapped from more than one Ensembl gene are excluded rather than combined without a source-defined aggregation rule.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer computes library-size CPM across all 60,671 source rows for each retained biopsy, applies log2(CPM + 1), maps source Ensembl identifiers to pinned GRCh38 gene symbols and excludes ambiguous symbols. Values are intended only for within-cohort analysis.

endpoints.label: Source-defined overall survival
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause as encoded by the GEO osevent field
